manual_review_reason: WFMU's official Send Music page explicitly accepts vinyl, CD, CD-R and cassette materials for review addressed to Music Director Jessica Romoff and links to a first-party Music Department contact form. The form requires JavaScript and exposes only name, email, subject and message fields; no digital audio-delivery procedure, accepted links or files, metadata rules, international digital eligibility, explicit-content policy or AI-origin policy is published. A human may use the form only for a concise asset-free process inquiry or separately approve the physical route. Do not attach or link audio in the inquiry, guess a hidden email address, automate JavaScript or anti-spam controls, send through both routes, or proceed if CAPTCHA, login, payment, consent or another protected workflow appears.
